task: Place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE after removing the obstacle in front of the CAR.
plan_summary: The robot CAR needs to place the MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE. The FRONT_CRATE is an obstacle in front of the robot (between the robot and the MEDICINE_BOTTLE). The plan is: 1) Navigate to FRONT_CRATE, 2) Pick up FRONT_CRATE, 3) Navigate to TEMP_ZONE, 4) Place FRONT_CRATE at TEMP_ZONE, 5) Navigate to MEDICINE_BOTTLE, 6) Pick up MEDICINE_BOTTLE, 7) Navigate to MEDICAL_TABLE, 8) Place MEDICINE_BOTTLE on MEDICAL_TABLE.
assumptions: FRONT_CRATE is the obstacle in front of the CAR that needs to be removed
TEMP_ZONE is a suitable temporary location to place the obstacle
The interaction_distance of 2.0 allows picking/placing when the robot is navigated to the object's coordinates
A tolerance of 0.5 is sufficient for navigation
